content: linecorp/line-bot-sdk (official LINE Messaging API PHP SDK on Packagist, github.com/line/line-bot-sdk-php) requires PHP 8.2+ and covers webhook signature verification, message content download (GET /v2/bot/message/{id}/content), and push/reply message building - worth adding as a Composer dependency instead of hand-rolling LineClient.php from raw Guzzle calls; reduces custom code surface for a security-sensitive integration (signature check) without conflicting with the project's 'no framework, no build step' constraint (it's a backend-only library).
